description: Local WOD runtime database schema contract; validates an existing database and cannot construct one.

summon_action_settings.description: Per-summon-definition battle action settings using the same JSON shape as hero_action_settings.

summon_archetype_skills.description: Assignment of catalogued summon skills to summon archetypes, including unlock level and level expression.

summon_archetypes.description: Stable identity shared by all tiers and level variants of the same summon.

summon_definitions.description: Summon recipes and level-range variants. summon_skill_id is a generated catalog ID such as skill-2094.

summon_skills.description: Global summon skill metadata catalog; assignment to summons is stored in summon_archetype_skills.

uniqueness_ledger.description: 历史遗留空表；模拟器不产生掉落，保留结构以兼容现有数据库，运行时代码不读写。
